response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length > 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_length DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Films with NULL length are excluded by the length > 112 filter. Grouping is by film.language_id (not original_language_id). Only languages with at least one qualifying film appear. NULLS LAST is stated explicitly for the ordering.
